config.label: Wontopos API key (wos-live-
config.description: Wontopos API key (wos-live-...). Create one in the console at wontopos.com.

config.label: Default store for every tool call (default: "default")
config.description: Default store for every tool call (default: "default").

config.label: Engine to read with: tablet-2 (default — same token price as tablet-1, and the one that serves photos and re-ask), tablet-1, scroll-1, or scroll-1
config.description: Engine to read with: tablet-2 (default — same token price as tablet-1, and the one that serves photos and re-ask), tablet-1, scroll-1, or scroll-1.2.

config.label: Default re-ask passes for search, 0-3 (default 0)
config.description: Default re-ask passes for search, 0-3 (default 0). Each pass is another engine call and is billed for what it delivers; the agent can raise it per call.

config.label: Default photo results per search, 0-5 (default 0)
config.description: Default photo results per search, 0-5 (default 0). Zero because these rows ride on every search; the view_image tool fetches the one picture that is wanted.

config.label: A different API host
config.description: A different API host. Leave unset for the default.

config.label: Per-request timeout in ms (default 20000)
config.description: Per-request timeout in ms (default 20000). A stalled API then fails in-band instead of hanging the host.

config.label: Set to 1 for read-only mode: recall/search/list_memories/engram/stats/revisions only, no write or delete tools
config.description: Set to 1 for read-only mode: recall/search/list_memories/engram/stats/revisions only, no write or delete tools.

config.label: Set to 1 to let tools take a user_id argument (multi-store)
config.description: Set to 1 to let tools take a user_id argument (multi-store). Default: every call is pinned to WONTOPOS_USER_ID.

config.label: Serve over HTTP on this port instead of stdio, for hosts that cannot spawn a local process
config.description: Serve over HTTP on this port instead of stdio, for hosts that cannot spawn a local process. Requires WONTOPOS_HTTP_TOKEN.

config.label: Bearer token every HTTP request must carry
config.description: Bearer token every HTTP request must carry. Required whenever WONTOPOS_HTTP_PORT is set.

config.label: Interface to bind in HTTP mode
config.description: Interface to bind in HTTP mode. Default 127.0.0.1 (this machine only).

config.label: Comma-separated Host header values to accept in HTTP mode, for a tunnel that forwards its own public name
config.description: Comma-separated Host header values to accept in HTTP mode, for a tunnel that forwards its own public name. Loopback and the bind address are always accepted; anything else is refused 403.
